design_audit.description: Thinking Step. Format: 'DRAFT: [target word] -> [Original Academic Sentence Plan] -> [3 Distractor Traps (Near-synonym / Register / Collocation Trap)]'. Must match CEFR {cefr_level}.

target_word.description: The specific vocabulary word selected from the list for this question.

question.description: The assessment sentence. Use exactly four underscores (____) for the blank. Do NOT include options or labels (A, B, C, D) inside this field.

options.description: Exactly 4 options containing the target_word and the 3 planned distractors. Return ONLY the literal word/phrase without labels like 'A)' or surrounding quotes (" ").

correct_answer_index.description: Index of the target_word inside the options array (0-3).

definition.description: A concise academic definition of the target word.

explanation.description: Contrastive pedagogical explanation explaining why the target word is the most accurate/natural choice in this specific context AND why key distractors are invalid (e.g., preposition mismatch, register, semantic nuance).
